name: Human Anatomy
description: Skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular, nervous, and visceral gross anatomy and spatial relationships.

topics.name: Cardiovascular Anatomy
topics.description: Heart chambers, great vessels, coronary circulation

questions.prompt: Which heart valve prevents backflow of oxygenated blood from the left ventricle into the left atrium during ventricular systole?
questions.explanation: The mitral (bicuspid) valve is located between the left atrium and left ventricle.

questions.prompt: Which cranial nerve provides parasympathetic innervation to thoracic and abdominal viscera including the heart and GI tract?
questions.explanation: The Vagus nerve (CN X) carries extensive parasympathetic autonomic fibers to organs in the thorax and abdomen.
